main_text.p: nitur, כל שיש בח עשרה כטלנים פחות מבאן ח"ו כפר / qua habet DECEM OTIOSOS; adeo quidem, ut si quæ decem otiosos non habeat, illa respectu lectionis libelli Ester eodem loco habeatur quo villa, quemadmodum id clarius in Gemara dicitur, fol. 3. col. 2. fine, ואמר רבי יהושע בן לוי כרך שאין בה י' בטלנין נידון ככפר / Et R. Iosua F. Levi dixit, oppidum in quo non sunt decem otiosi, ÆSTIMATUR villa. In quibus omnibus nihil est, quod Synagogam iis solis locis includat, ubi decem otiosi inveniuntur. Quid quod contrarium inde satis liqueat, quod hic loca esse supponantur, quæ non quidem decem, quibus impares sint, sed tamen aliquot otiosos alant, פחות מכאן pauciores quam decem? & quod lectio historiæ Ester etiam in oppidis obtineat? quorum neutrum sane absque Synagoga esse potest.

XIII. Alter locus à Cl. Lightfooto ex Maimonide adducitur, Hilch. Tephil. Cap. xi. §. 1. כל מקום שיש בו עשרה מישראל צריך להכין לו בית שיכנסו בו לתפילה בכל עת תפילה ומקום זה נקרא בית הכנסת In quocunque loco sunt DECEM ISRAELITÆ, ibi necesse est domum condere, in qua conveniant ad precandum omni tempore precationis, & hic locus vocatur Synagoga. Sed quæso te, Lector, quid clarius dici poterat in nostram sententiam? Cl. Lightfooto autem cæterisque Viris Doctis magis adversum? Probandum erat Lightfooto, Non formatam esse Synagogam, nisi ubi decem Otiosi, i.e. literati, ex professo studiosi legu, cujusmodi homines in majoribus urbibus tantum inveniuntur, non item in oppidis & vicis. Lightfooto autem" follow the printed text; the words "Cl. Lightfooto autem cæterisque Viris Doctis magis adversum?" are as printed, with an unclear punctuation mark. "Probandum erat Lightfooto" has an uncertain word after "erat" (printed as an ornamented or distorted letter). The phrase "ex professo studiosi legu" ends in a printed form that may be "legunt". The paragraph ends mid-sentence on "(nullo", which continues on the next page. Bottom-left marks are scan artefacts and not transcribed.
